en: Vintage sepia postcard view of a wooded valley town. In the foreground stands a large, ornate multi‑storey institutional building. On the wooded hillside above, to the right, is a church with a tall tower and spire. Hills rise in the background. The top caption reads "Tharandt. Forstakademie und Kirche." and the bottom margin credits the publisher "Brück & Sohn, Meissen" along with the number 4515.
